clauses.name: register-with-daemon
clauses.obligation: Agent must call agent.register with a daemon-issued registrationNonce and articlesSignature before any tool use.
clauses.denialShape: every tool call before a successful agent.register is refused with UNREGISTERED_AGENT

clauses.name: stream-transcript-events
clauses.obligation: Agent must stream every tool call, tool result, shell command, and stop reason as a normalized transcript event.

clauses.name: route-destructive-tools-through-gate
clauses.obligation: Agent must route destructive git actions, secret reads, and writes outside the workspace through the daemon's pre-tool gate.
clauses.denialShape: the tool call is rejected with PD_TOOL_DENIED and the id of the violated policy

clauses.name: respect-token-and-cost-budget
clauses.obligation: Agent must halt and request an extension once accrued cost or token usage crosses the harbor's configured budget.
clauses.denialShape: the tool-use capability lease expires and is not renewed, returning BUDGET_LEASE_EXPIRED on the next tool call

clauses.name: accept-operator-interrupt
clauses.obligation: Agent must yield control within one turn when the daemon issues a pause or interrupt control signal.
clauses.denialShape: the process-supervision hook suspends the body process regardless of agent cooperation and marks the turn interrupted

clauses.name: claim-files-before-editing
clauses.obligation: Agent must register a file or symbol claim with the daemon before editing it, and release the claim on completion.
clauses.denialShape: the coordination MCP gateway rejects a conflicting edit tool call with CLAIM_CONFLICT and the competing claimant's agent id

clauses.name: respond-to-parley-within-window
clauses.obligation: Agent must acknowledge an incoming parley request within the harbor's configured response window.
